comparison.objective: Lift and hold a no-touch thermometer over a forehead mark, then return it upright; candidate commissions a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: PR tests grasping, free-space hover positioning, steady holding, and replacement; candidate tests inserted-tool manipulation, bimanual stabilization, fine rotation, locking torque, and response-based adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires a successful hover/hold and upright return; candidate requires two safe energy-absorbing stops and verified setting retention.
comparison.reason: Hover sensing and tool return do not test adjustment, locking, or dynamic impact behavior. No spec versions or hover distance/duration thresholds are provided.
